name: apostrophe
description_en: A full-featured, open-source content management framework built with Node.js that empowers organizations by combining in-context editing and headless architecture in a full-stack JS environment.
readme_excerpt: ApostropheCMS Full-stack CMS for developers and content teams Build websites with in-context editing and headless flexibility using Node.js and MongoDB. Documentation » Demo · Roadmap · Report Bug About ApostropheCMS is a full-stack content management system built with Node.js and MongoDB. Content creators can edit directly on live pages without switching between admin interfaces, while developers can build with modern JavaScript or use it headlessly with any frontend framework.
